source.name: ASTRA Bio wave 1 — Periplaneta americana (Cockroach)
source.license: Original syllabus-based practice questions (exam-frequent themes; not verbatim past papers)

questions.stem: The body of Periplaneta is divided into
options: cephalothorax and abdomen as in prawn only
questions.explanation: Insects have three tagmata: head, thorax and abdomen, covered by a chitinous cuticle.

questions.stem: The mandibles of the cockroach are used for
questions.explanation: Periplaneta has mandibulate (biting-chewing) mouthparts with strong mandibles.

questions.stem: The gizzard (proventriculus) of the cockroach is lined with
options: thick cuticle and chitinous teeth for grinding
questions.explanation: Six cuticular teeth in the gizzard grind food before it enters the mesenteron.

questions.stem: Circulation in Periplaneta is described as open because
options: blood remains only inside a closed network of capillaries
haemolymph flows in haemocoel and bathes the tissues
oxygen is carried by haemoglobin in RBC
questions.explanation: Haemolymph is pumped by the dorsal heart into sinuses; there are no tissue capillaries.

questions.stem: The number of pairs of spiracles in Periplaneta is
questions.explanation: Ten pairs: two thoracic and eight abdominal spiracles open into the tracheal system.

questions.stem: Uric acid is the main nitrogenous waste of the cockroach, so it is
questions.explanation: Malpighian tubules and the fat body contribute to uricotelic excretion, conserving water.

questions.stem: Compound eyes of Periplaneta are made of many visual units called
questions.explanation: Each ommatidium contributes a fragment of the image, producing mosaic vision.

questions.stem: The mushroom-shaped gland in the male cockroach is
questions.explanation: Utricular and phallic glands (mushroom gland) add secretions to the seminal fluid.

questions.stem: The ootheca of Periplaneta is a
options: dark purse-like egg case produced by collateral glands
questions.explanation: Collateral glands secrete the ootheca, which contains a double row of fertilised eggs.

questions.stem: Forewings of the cockroach that protect the hindwings are called
options: elytra of beetles only by another name never used
questions.explanation: Leathery mesothoracic tegmina cover the membranous metathoracic flying wings.

questions.stem: Hepatic caeca of the cockroach arise at the junction of
questions.explanation: Eight blind hepatic (gastric) caeca open into the anterior midgut and secrete digestive enzymes.

questions.stem: Anal styles that distinguish the male cockroach are attached to the
questions.explanation: Short, unjointed anal styles on the 9th sternum occur in males; both sexes have anal cerci on the 10th segment.

questions.stem: Which statement about Periplaneta americana is incorrect?
options: The heart is a dorsal pulsatile tube of 13 chambers
Each thoracic segment bears a pair of walking legs
Development is paurometabolous with nymphs resembling adults
Oxygen is transported mainly by haemoglobin in haemolymph
questions.explanation: Tracheae deliver oxygen directly to tissues; haemolymph has little respiratory pigment.

questions.stem: In Periplaneta the head is formed by the fusion of how many embryonic segments?
questions.explanation: Six segments fuse to form the hypognathous head that bears antennae, palps and mouthparts.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a mouthpart of the cockroach?
questions.explanation: Labrum, mandibles, maxillae, labium and hypopharynx are mouthparts; tegmina are forewings.

questions.stem: The crop of Periplaneta functions mainly as a
questions.explanation: The thin-walled crop stores food; grinding occurs in the gizzard just behind it.

questions.stem: Ostia of the cockroach heart are
options: paired openings that admit haemolymph into the chambers
questions.explanation: Each heart chamber has lateral ostia with valves; blood enters from the pericardial sinus.

questions.stem: Tracheoles of the cockroach end blindly on the tissues so that
options: gaseous exchange occurs directly at the cells
questions.explanation: Fine fluid-filled tracheoles lie against cells; oxygen diffuses to mitochondria without using lungs.

questions.stem: Malpighian tubules of Periplaneta open at the junction of the
questions.explanation: Yellow thread-like tubules (about 100–150) arise at the midgut–hindgut junction and extract nitrogenous waste.

questions.stem: The brain of the cockroach is the
questions.explanation: Paired supra-oesophageal ganglia above the oesophagus form the brain, linked to a sub-oesophageal ganglion.

questions.stem: Phallomeres in the male cockroach are
options: chitinous external genitalia around the gonopore
questions.explanation: Three asymmetrical phallomeres (gonapophyses) surround the male genital opening and aid copulation.

questions.stem: In the female cockroach the 7th sternum is boat-shaped and together with the 8th and 9th sterna forms the
questions.explanation: The genital pouch lodges gonapophyses, spermathecal openings and the collaterial gland openings; oothecae form here.

questions.stem: Nymphs of Periplaneta grow to adults by a series of moults. This development is
options: as in frogs with a tadpole
questions.explanation: Cockroaches are paurometabolous: wingless nymphs resemble adults and gain wings after several instars; there is no pupa.

questions.stem: Each walking leg of Periplaneta consists of
options: coxa, trochanter, femur, tibia and tarsus
protopodite and exopodite as in prawn gills
questions.explanation: The typical insect leg has five podomeres; the tarsus is further jointed and ends in claws.

questions.stem: How many oothecae does a female Periplaneta produce on average, each with about 14–16 eggs?
options: none; eggs are laid singly in water
questions.explanation: A female produces roughly 9–10 oothecae; each dark case holds two rows of eggs.

questions.stem: Which of the following is incorrect for Periplaneta americana?
options: Fat body assists in storage and excretion
Sense organs include antennae, eyes, maxillary palps and anal cerci
The ventral nerve cord is absent; only a dorsal brain exists
questions.explanation: A double ventral nerve cord with three thoracic and six abdominal ganglia runs the length of the body.
